summary: Eos Energy Enterprises filed an 8-K reporting a binding term sheet with Cerberus affiliate CCM Frontier to form a joint venture. CCM Frontier contributes $100M and receives Class A-1/A-2 Units; Eos contributes rights offering proceeds for Class B Units. JV formation is pending definitive agreements, rights offering, and closing conditions. No acquisition, divestiture, or change of control is described; the filing is an agreement to form an entity with future capital commitments. This is a structured financing/JV arrangement, not a standalone special-situation event.
